info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Trust Services Management API
info.description: The Corporate Trust Services Management API allows users to update and manage corporate trust account details effectively. This API facilitates operations such as modifying existing trust agreements, adjusting account parameters, and handling service requests. It is tailored for financial institutions and corporate entities that require robust trust service management capabilities. With this API, users can ensure compliance and maintain accurate records while streamlining their corporate trust operations.

patch.description: This operation allows clients to update the details of a specific Corporate Trust Service identified by its resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to successfully update the service.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating corporate trust services with the specified ID. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing resources.
